settings.store: SqliteMemoryStore(':memory:'), a fresh one per strategy
settings.recall: HybridRetriever.recall(question, { limit: k, validAt, contentWords: true, expand: true, stateIntent: kind === 'now' }); validAt is the dataset's `now`, or the instant an as-of question names

strategies.append-only: every statement an ordinary fact (addNode, validFrom = its date); nothing is closed
strategies.append-only+freshness: the same store, recalled with freshness: 1
strategies.current-state: every statement through recordState(subject, aspect, text, at); a newer state closes the one it replaces

caveats: The subject and aspect of each statement come from the dataset; a host model would have to choose them.
As-of questions are given their instant; a host model would have to read it from the question.
It compares the library with itself, with and without invalidation — not with any other system.

metrics.currentAt1: the first result is the statement true at the instant asked
metrics.staleAt1: the first result is another statement of the same subject (the reader would most likely repeat it)
metrics.currentInTopK: the true statement is among the first k
metrics.staleInTopK: another statement of the same subject is among the first k
metrics.cleanTopK: the true statement is among the first k and no other statement of its subject is
